SELECT mp.*, IFNULL(mm.moduleNum,0) AS moduleNum, IFNULL(me.endpointNum,0) AS endpointNum, IFNULL(me.assetNum,0) AS assetNum, IFNULL(msg.alertNum,0) AS alertNum FROM monitor_project mp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, count( 1 ) AS moduleNum FROM monitor_module GROUP BY project_id ) mm ON mm.project_id = mp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.project_id, count( 1 ) AS endpointNum, count( DISTINCT e.asset_id ) AS assetNum FROM monitor_endpoint e LEFT JOIN monitor_module m ON e.module_id = m.id GROUP BY m.project_id ) me ON mp.id = me.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, count( 1 ) AS alertNum FROM alert_message_active WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id ) msg ON mp.id = msg.project_id
mp.id in
#{id}
AND mp.name like CONCAT('%', #{params.name}, '%')
